Create an implicit (regular-grid) coordinate

Source: R/coordinate.R
ImplicitCoord.Rd

Create an implicit (regular-grid) coordinate

Usage

ImplicitCoord(
  dimension = character(0),
  n = integer(0),
  offset = numeric(0),
  step = numeric(0)
)

Arguments

dimension

Dimension name (character, length 1)

n

Number of elements (integer, length 1)

offset

Start value (numeric, length 1)

step

Step size (numeric, length 1)

Examples

lat <- ImplicitCoord(dimension = "lat", n = 180L, offset = -89.5, step = 1.0)
coord_values(lat)  # -89.5, -88.5, ..., 89.5
